name: sap-abap
description: Skills for SAP ABAP development across customer-managed and cloud systems: Standard ABAP on SAP ECC 6.0, SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP, and SAP S/4HANA (on premises or on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud VMs), enhancements and integration, plus ABAP Cloud with RAP and clean core assessments.

settings.name: SAP system URL
settings.description: ICM URL of the ABAP system, for example https://host:44300 or http://localhost:50000 for the trial. Prefer HTTPS.

settings.name: SAP user
settings.description: User name for the ABAP system. A read-only user is enough.

settings.name: SAP password
settings.description: Password of that user. Stored in the agent's secure credential store, never in the plugin.

settings.name: Logon language
settings.description: Two-letter logon language, for example EN.
